diagnosis: Checks C2 and C3, which are supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (active-probing telemetry), passed in rollouts 0 and 1 despite the decision-maker having no access to PF1. In these rollouts, the model defaulted to an initial_rollout_percent of 10 and waf_rule_enabled: true, which matches the exact values required by PF1, suggesting the model is pattern-matching common 'afe' deployment parameters.
